comment: fix: Restore short-circuit semantics in Vega-Lite expressions and warn and exclude rows when filter evaluation fails. Nonaggregate vertical bar, line, and area charts without timeUnit render the native no-data display when successful filtering exhausts populated data whose encoded fields validate before the exhausting filter, preserving healthy concat siblings. Empty eligibility is read-only and excludes temporal or aggregate normalization. Preserve populated exhaustion evidence across successive filters. Execute authored stacked-bar and line/point-overlay transforms once per contributing series. Keep temporal normalization local so repeated successful or failed preparation preserves caller-owned timeUnit and aggregate declarations. Overlay temporal projection preserves individual observations unless y.aggregate explicitly requests count, sum, mean, average, median, min, or max, grouped by x and color. Shared temporal bar reduction also honors these declared operations instead of substituting mean for min, max, or median; unsupported temporal or overlay reducers throw. Resolve overlay colors from their own encoding. Explicit array color domains pair bar colors by domain position rather than first-seen row order, which can change existing stacked-bar colors. Bar-domain reservations do not shift independent line fallback colors, and non-array domains retain color fallback without throwing. Empty source data, invalid encoded fields, and filter-error depletion retain strict validation and can throw during rendering. Other adapters retain mark-specific empty-data handling: histogram and polar can throw on a guarded no-match that previously retained rows after eager evaluation failed. Callers needing containment of invalid child specs must handle render errors externally. Filters remain display-only, not authorization controls.
